answer: Identity bonds with natural decay block fake identities. Each agent locks a 60-token bond that loses 2 tokens per idle epoch, fading like a trail over a knoll. To stay active it must do work before dawn each epoch and pass a peer check; a failed check or a canyon-sized gap in its history burns the rest. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 tokens, far above any fake reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
